verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-decisioning platform, so an agent-operable review queue is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents no such capability: it shows only order submission, a per-order Get Decision lookup, and decision webhooks. Nothing covers listing flagged or manual-review cases with their context, agent-side evidence summarization, or a recommend-then-human-confirm workflow; at most these are developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the review queue — pull flagged cases with their context, summarize the evidence, and recommend a decision for a human to confirm
